verdict.rationale: Mirrors does surface insights from the user's own data inside the product: it shows recurring mistakes across production runs and compares outcomes against holdout groups. The evidence never says these insights are AI-generated, and the corrections themselves are written by the user or their coding agent, not suggested by Mirrors. Missing for 10: evidence that the insights are AI-generated, product-generated suggestions or recommended corrections, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
